name: Ylva
title: Of the Fisher Steps
examine: She fishes the one water in the Dawnlands that nobody else wants, and she is fed, so the argument is settled.
lines: Cold water, slow fish, big fish. You want quick, go to the ford.
The steps are the only place on this water a child is allowed. Mind that.
I have never once seen it freeze. Torvi has. We do not discuss it.
